title: Import
allPassed: Every row passed. Nothing needs your attention.
historyHint: Re-importing a file you have already imported creates nothing.
nothingYet: Nothing imported into this portfolio yet.
transactionsCreatedHint: Ordinary transactions. Holdings and P&L are derived from them like any other.
noneCreated: None. Either every row was a duplicate, or the import failed.
rejectedHint: These never became transactions. Fix them in the file and import it again — what already succeeded will not be created twice.
duplicatesHint: Skipped rather than created a second time. This is what makes re-importing a file safe.
